title: Brent sees a fatal motorcycle crash at age five

tellings.quote: when the back tire hits that water, her bike slides, stops, flips her, she goes

plain: In 1968, when he was five years old, Brent Friedman says he watched a woman die in a motorcycle crash in the Berkeley Hills of California. Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood and UFOs, describes it as something he saw himself: her back tire hit some water, the bike slid, stopped, flipped her, and she was gone.
